note: Total Control ships an admin dashboard at /admin/dashboard built as a Page Manager (Panels) page (config page_manager.page.total_control_dashboard), requiring page_manager/panels/ctools/block/views/contextual. Access is gated by the single permission 'have total control', stamped onto the page route by RouteSubscriber. It provides 7 Dashboard-category block plugins used as panes (content_overview, create_content, administer_content_types, administer_menus, administer_taxonomy, administer_panel_pages, total_control_dashboard) and control_* Views (control_content at /admin/dashboard/content/all, control_users at /admin/dashboard/users, control_terms at /admin/dashboard/categories, control_comments when comment enabled). No settings form / config schema. Medium reads back a live role's permission and the dashboard page path; hard cases grant the permission to a role and place a Total Control pane block, verified live. Fixtures namespaced tc_*.

evals.prompt: What does the Total Control module give you in Drupal, at what path is its dashboard, and which permission controls access to it?
evals.expected_output: It provides a ready-made administration dashboard at /admin/dashboard (a Page Manager/Panels page) with overview, admin-link and content/user listing panes. Access is gated by the 'have total control' permission.

evals.prompt: Which contributed modules does Total Control depend on to build its dashboard, and how is the dashboard page implemented?
evals.expected_output: It depends on ctools, panels and page_manager (plus core block, views, contextual). The dashboard is a Page Manager page (page_manager.page.total_control_dashboard) with a Panels variant at /admin/dashboard.

evals.prompt: Name some of the panes (block plugins) and the Views that Total Control provides for its dashboard.
evals.expected_output: Pane block plugins (Dashboard category) include content_overview, create_content, administer_content_types, administer_menus, administer_taxonomy, administer_panel_pages and total_control_dashboard. Views include control_content (/admin/dashboard/content/all), control_users (/admin/dashboard/users), their *_panes variants, control_terms and control_comments.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which custom role has been granted access to the Total Control admin dashboard (the 'have total control' permission)? Inspect the live site.
evals.expected_output: The tc_role role has the 'have total control' permission, so users in that role can see /admin/dashboard.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, at what URL path is the Total Control Page Manager dashboard page served, and is that page currently enabled? Inspect the live page_manager configuration.
evals.expected_output: The page_manager.page.total_control_dashboard page is served at /admin/dashboard and is enabled (status: true).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a role named tc_task. Using Total Control, give that role access to the administration dashboard by granting it the appropriate permission. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Grant the 'have total control' permission to the tc_task role (e.g. `drush role:perm:add tc_task 'have total control'` or via People > Permissions).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, place Total Control's 'Content Overview' dashboard pane (the content_overview block plugin) as a block in the content region of the default theme, with the block machine name tc_overview_block. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a block config entity id=tc_overview_block using plugin content_overview in the default theme's content region (e.g. Block::create([...'plugin' => 'content_overview'...])->save() or via Block layout).
